name: solar_sufficiency_ratio
formula_or_definition: available solar-bus energy divided by planned compute plus support plus losses plus required storage replenishment
minimum_evidence: orbit-resolved array and load model with assumptions

name: service_fulfillment
formula_or_definition: validated compute service delivered divided by validated service requested
minimum_evidence: workload definition plus telemetry and quality threshold

name: critical_reserve_coverage
formula_or_definition: usable stored energy above required reserve divided by critical load power

name: power_headroom
formula_or_definition: available end-of-life bus capacity minus concurrent compute and support load
minimum_evidence: metered or qualified bus and load models

name: thermal_headroom
formula_or_definition: verified radiator rejection at current state minus total modeled heat load
minimum_evidence: thermal model correlated to test with environment and surface aging

name: communications_headroom
formula_or_definition: available sustained link throughput minus required workload traffic
minimum_evidence: measured link performance and traffic profile

name: curtailed_solar_energy
formula_or_definition: available solar energy not captured or used under stated configuration
minimum_evidence: attitude and array model or telemetry

name: unmet_service
formula_or_definition: requested validated compute service not delivered

name: lifecycle_energy_intensity
formula_or_definition: manufacturing plus launch plus ground support plus operational energy divided by validated useful service
minimum_evidence: metered and supplier data with allocation method

name: material_recovery_fraction
formula_or_definition: requalified reused plus verified recycled material mass divided by retired recoverable material mass

name: unrecovered_material_mass
formula_or_definition: mass retired without verified reuse or recovery
minimum_evidence: as-built bill of materials and disposition evidence

name: terrestrial_burden_transfer
formula_or_definition: grid energy plus water plus fuel plus attributable manufacturing and launch burden by source
minimum_evidence: source and supplier records with allocation method

name: net_service_capacity_added
formula_or_definition: validated new service capacity minus capacity lost to degradation outage and retirement

name: abundance_claim_scope
formula_or_definition: stated boundary time horizon population served and evidence classes
